query: SELECT thread_id AS "thread_id!", MAX(creada_en) AS "ultimo", MAX(compartida)::BIGINT AS "compartida" FROM ( SELECT c.thread_id, c.creada_en, CASE WHEN c.mensaje_clave IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE ( SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT o.thread_id) FROM mp_respuestas_cache o WHERE o.catalog_hash = c.catalog_hash AND o.precio_hash = c.precio_hash AND o.mensaje_clave = c.mensaje_clave AND o.origen IS DISTINCT FROM 'releer' ) END AS compartida FROM mp_respuestas_cache c WHERE c.thread_id = ANY($1) AND c.origen IS DISTINCT FROM 'releer' ) t GROUP BY thread_id
